findings.message: Route contract authority is limited to docs/eng/ documents.
Documentation semantics exclude generated, evidence, facts, governance, user, legacy, and scratch docs from route authority.
All explicitly excluded routes are approved out-of-scope exceptions.
All runtime routes are in canonical /api path families.
Domain/workflow alignment covers 11 current SGP domain modules.
Portal menu alignment covers 34 implemented route(s) and 3 postponed identity route(s).
Admin menu alignment covers 6 installed route(s) and keeps 175 route(s) under ADMIN_INSTALL_LATER.
